one_liner: Online payment processing and financial infrastructure platform for internet businesses.
auth_notes: Uses standard Bearer tokens / API keys (restricted or standard keys prefixed with sk_test_ or sk_live_) sent in the Authorization header.
gate_notes: Anyone can create a free account and immediately obtain test/live API keys.
verdict_reason: Stripe provides an exceptionally comprehensive, well-documented REST API with self-serve test credentials and official SDKs, making it fully ready for AI agent integration.

extras.rate_limit_note: Stripe imposes rate limits based on per-endpoint buckets (typically up to 100 req/sec for live mode reads and writes, higher in test mode).

evidence.quote: The Stripe API is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
